lake_statistic: Rasterize Natural Earth lake polygon inset by half the overview pixel diagonal at provider-overview pixel centres, using already acquired tiles touched by source lake nodes. A repeated exact float32 value is selected only with >=8 pixels, >=10% of in-polygon pixels and >=2x runner-up support; tied counts choose the lower value. If no dominant flat plateau is isolated, use the in-polygon pixel median and mark weak_support. Retain counts, range and quartiles. These are static modeled levels, not surveyed or current measurements. Natural Earth enclosed-water polygons exclude mapped land islands.

lakes.name: Professor Doctor Ingenieur W. J. Van Blommestein Meer

limitations: Static historical surface model, not current lake gauges, tides, or flood/levee simulation
Natural Earth is generalized; average overview pixels can mix water and land
Small lakes with one coarse sample have weak support; the complete support and spread are recorded
DSM includes vegetation and structures; the sparse corrections do not claim a bare-earth local survey
Remaining ocean H is raw bathymetry here; packer must replace ocean H with0 before physical-surface interpolation
method: All Natural Earth lake nodes, the enclosed Caspian Sea ring, and remaining negative Natural Earth land nodes are independently checked against Copernicus hydro-edited surface heights. No negative-height ocean classification or global clamping is performed. Dry land keeps the selected provider surface value. Each lake is modeled at the dominant flat provider value within inset lake geometry when independently supported; otherwise it uses an explicitly uncertain in-polygon pixel median.
missing_tile_policy: For candidate dry-land nodes only, a tile absent from the pinned official public tile inventory gives H0 following provider documentation for absent ocean tiles. Never fabricate a lake elevation from a missing tile; require independent sample support.
sample_method: Nearest pixel in provider average-downsampled smallest COG overview: floor((native_pixel_coordinate+0.5)*overview_size/base_size), clamped to image bounds; TIFF RasterPixelIsPoint tiepoint and pixel scale define native_pixel_coordinate. No additional pointwise datum transform.
source_product: Copernicus GLO-90 AWS 2021 public COGs, native90m product with provider-created average overviews
vertical_datum: EGM2008 orthometric metres, provider-declared; same datum as NOAA ETOPO2022
